title: Seabreeze 30A | Real Joy
meta_description: Top Reasons to Book this Fabulous Beach Home:* Across the street from the beach-Steps to Beach Access!* 2 Bikes Included* Steps to the Community Pool* Private decks on every level-Great Views!* Close to 30A Shopping and Dining* Professionally Managed;
description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Fabulous Beach Home:* Across the street from the beach-Steps to Beach Access!* 2 Bikes Included* Steps to the Community Pool* Private decks on every level-Great Views!* Close to 30A Shopping and Dining* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions. *Welcome to Seabreeze 30A, a fabulous three-story, 4-bedroom, 4-bathroom beach home located in the charming Seabreeze Cottages community along scenic 30A! Situated just across the street from the beautiful sugar-white beaches and minutes from 30A’s renowned shopping and dining. The first floor features a king guest bedroom with a private bathroom and patio access, along with a second guest bedroom with two queen beds and a private bathroom. The second floor is the heart of the home, featuring an open-concept living, dining, and kitchen area with coastal décor and breakfast bar seating for four, and a dining table. This level also includes a bunk room with a queen bed and a twin-over-full bunk bed. The third floor is home to the spacious master king suite, complete with a private bathroom and balcony where you can relax and enjoy beautiful Gulf views. Each level of the home offers its own outdoor deck, providing plenty of opportunities to soak up the sunshine and coastal scenery. Guests can also enjoy the community pool just steps from the home, making Seabreeze 30A the perfect 30A retreat for families and groups looking to relax, unwind, and enjoy everything the Emerald Coast has to offer.The Bed Setup:1st Floor:Guest Bedroom 1: King BedGuest Bedroom 2: 2 Queen Beds2nd Floor:Guest Bedroom 3: Queen Bed + Twin-over-Full Bed3rd Floor:Master Bedroom: King Bed + Twin Sleeper ChairArea Attractions:Rosemary Beach is only minutes away, with shops and restaurants, including the Old World-style town center w/coffee shop, bike and surf rentals, and unique shops. Check out the open-air markets on the weekends. Enjoy the beautiful sugar-white sand beaches that made 30A world famous. Enjoy walking and biking everywhere around Rosemary, Seacrest, and Alys Beach. Don't miss the newly opened 30Avenue for even more dining and shopping options. 30Avenue is just north of Rosemary across Hwy 98, near both Shades Sports Bar and The Donut Hole. This laid-back, fun family atmosphere awaits you! Come stay and play, and see for yourself what makes our community and the 30A area so special! The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
